start: Member with 4 lifts that beat their best in the last 30 days and weigh-ins 30 days apart

user_sees: '4 lifts beat their best ...' then '· N records, newest first'
must_not: Every kind of record counted as a separate lift

must_not: A different number from the Records page for the same days

user_sees: '<weight> kg now' and a pill like '+1.2 kg' with 'in 30 days', green or red by the member's goal
must_not: A change with no time span
A change worked out from two weigh-ins on the same day

user_sees: The month picture with the same 'lifts beat their best' count as the month report
must_not: Two different counts for the same month

user_sees: 'N lifts beat their best this month' or '1 lift beat its best this month'

No lifts counted as beating their best (first sets are never news)
must_not: The first workout counted as records
